# Trademark Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TrademarkStatus`](gmeow-TrademarkStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TrademarkStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The registration status of a trademark — a VALUE: unregistered (™), registered (®), pending, expired, or cancelled. Open vocabulary.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TrademarkStatus`](gmeow-TrademarkStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the trademark-status axis — the registration states (unregistered ™, registered ®, pending, expired, cancelled) a trademark declares via [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkStatus.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-status subclasses (statuses are individuals, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid reusing it for copyright or licence standing, which have their own vocabularies.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded value ([`gmeow:trademarkStatusRegistered`](../individuals/gmeow-trademarkStatusRegistered.md), [`gmeow:trademarkStatusExpired`](../individuals/gmeow-trademarkStatusExpired.md), …) from [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkStatus.md); mint a fresh individual only if a registry status outside the five seeds is needed.

### Examples

- ex:statusRegistered a [`gmeow:TrademarkStatus`](gmeow-TrademarkStatus.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "registered (®)"@en.
